title: 7 June 1968: Paul McCartney is best man at his brother Michael's wedding
content:
Paul McCartney was the best man at his brother Michael’s wedding on 7 June 1968.

Embed from Getty Images

Mike McCartney married Angela Fishwick, a hair stylist, at St Bridget’s Parish Church in the small village of Carrog in Merionethshire, north Wales. It was the same church where the McCartneys’ father Jim had married his second wife in November 1964.

Embed from Getty Images

The other Beatles sent congratulatory telegrams. George Harrison and Ringo Starr were both in California, while John Lennon remained in London.

The wedding reception was held at Jim McCartney’s home in Gayton, Cheshire. Paul led a singalong around the family piano.
